title: General Chiang Kai-Sheks Son Returns As A Result Of Co-Operation

page_data.en:
B1
MAINICHI
April 20, 1937.
4112
21 4 37

General Chiang Kai-shek's son returns as a result
of co-operation between Kuomintang and Communist
Party

On April 18 Chiang Ching-kuo, elder son of General
Chiang Kai-shek, in company with a certain Chen, member of the
communist party at Moscow, arrived at Shanghai on the Soviet
steamer "Sever" from Russia. He was received by representa-
tives of General Chiang Kai-shek and left secretly for a
certain destination. He will proceed to Hangchow to-day or
to-morrow to meet his father there.

Chiang Ching-kuo was strongly opposed to his father
because of the latter's treatment of his mother, the General's
former wife, his brother and himself after his marriage to the
present Madame Chiang, and because of the drastic action
against communists. Chiang Ching-kuo has come back to China
through the good offices of the Soviet Ambassador, Mr.
Bogomoloff and the Chinese Ambassador to Russia, Mr. Tang
Wen-i. This is a result of Sino-Soviet co-operation.
It is reported that communist leaders such as Chen Shao-
yui, Lee Lih San and Keng Sung, will return to China from
Moscow and Paris to strengthen the anti-Japanese front.

1937年4月20日。
4112

蒋介石将军之子回国，系国民党与共产党合作之结果

4月18日，蒋介石将军的长子蒋经国，在一名莫斯科共产党员陈某的陪同下，乘坐苏联轮船“塞维尔号”（Sever）从俄罗斯抵达上海。他受到蒋介石将军代表的接待，随后秘密前往某地。他将于今日或明日前往杭州，在那里与其父会面。

蒋经国曾强烈反对他的父亲，原因是其父在与现任蒋夫人结婚后，对待其生母（即将军的前妻）、其兄弟以及他本人的方式，以及因其对共产党人采取的严厉行动。蒋经国得以返回中国，是得益于苏联大使鲍格莫洛夫先生（Mr. Bogomoloff）和驻俄中国大使唐文仪先生（Mr. Tang Wen-i）的斡旋。这是中苏合作的结果。

据报，陈绍禹（Chen Shao-yui）、李立三（Lee Lih San）和耿松（Keng Sung，音译）等共产党领导人将从莫斯科和巴黎返回中国，以加强抗日战线。

Date October 13, 1932

Subject (in full) extract from French Intelligence Report.

Made by Supt. Tan Shao Liang Forwarded by Jno Robertson, Supt.

Reference to attached extract from French
Intelligence Report, the Chinese Authorities have
received no confirmation re the sons of Feng Yu Ziang
and Chiang Kai Shek having served in the Red Army in
Kiangsi. It is however, correct that Chen Fo Kuo,
son of Chen Ju Jen was shot at Canton for being a
Communist.

It is reported that Chiang King Kuo, the
son of Chiang Kai Shek is at Moscow, The Authorities
there do not permit him to leave for China.

Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent.

主题（完整）：法国情报报告摘录。

由谭绍良警司制作 由 Jno Robertson 警司转发

关于所附法国情报报告摘录，中国当局未收到任何证实，表明冯玉祥和蒋介石的儿子曾在江西红军中服役。然而，陈果夫（Chen Fo Kuo，即陈果夫），陈菊人（Chen Ju Jen，即陈其美/陈英士）之子，因身为共产党人在广州被枪决一事属实。

据报，蒋介石之子蒋经国（Chiang King Kuo）目前在莫斯科。当地当局不允许他离开前往中国。

Translation of an extract from the French Police Intelligence
Report dated October 11, 1932.
----------------------------------------

The following is the translation of an article which appeared in
the "Masses' Newspaper" on October 9, 1932;-

FENG HING KUO, the son of Marshal Feng Yu Hsiang, is now in
Kiangsi. He is under instructions from the Chinese Communist Party
to train young peasants, who at the finish of their training, will
form the Reserve for the Red Army in Kiangsi.
FENG YU HSIANG'S son is closely cooperating with the son of
CHIANG KAI SHEK - CHIANG KING KUO. The latter used to be the Red
Army's instructor at Kiangsi. In the spring of last year he was
made a Commander of the 3rd. Division of the 2nd. Red Army.
CHEN FO KUO, the son of CHEN JU JEN, an influential member of
the Kuomintang, was a superior officer in the Chinese Red Army.
He was taken prisoner in South Kiangsi by Cantonese troops, and
was shot in Kwantung by the order of General CHEN CHI TANG.

----------------------------------------

Supt. Ian,
any information please.

1932年10月11日法国警察情报报告摘录译文。
---

以下是1932年10月9日刊登在《群众报》（Masses' Newspaper）上的一篇文章的译文：-

冯玉祥元帅之子冯兴郭（FENG HING KUO，音译）目前在江西。他正按照中国共产党的指示训练年轻农民，这些农民在完成训练后，将组成江西红军的后备队。
冯玉祥之子与蒋介石之子——蒋经国（CHIANG KING KUO）密切合作。后者曾任江西红军的教官。去年春天，他被任命为红军第二军第三师师长。
陈果夫（CHEN FO KUO，即陈果夫），国民党有影响力的成员陈菊人（CHEN JU JEN，即陈其美/陈英士）之子，曾是中国红军的高级军官。他在江西南部被粤军俘虏，并根据陈济棠将军的命令在广东被枪决。

---

伊恩警司，
如有任何信息请告知。
